'''Jan Šimbera''' (born 3 November 1951) is a Czech former professional [[tennis]] player who competed for Czechoslovakia during the 1970s. He has served as team captain of the [[Czech Republic Fed Cup team]], which included an appearance in the semi-finals in 2000.<ref>{{cite news |title=Trenér Šimbera je na tenistky pyšný |url=https://www.idnes.cz/sport/tenis/trener-simbera-je-na-tenistky-pysny.A001122_124057_tenis_bra |work=[[Mafra (company)|iDNES.cz]] |date=22 November 2000 |language=Czech}}</ref>

Šimbera won the [[Scandinavian Indoor Championships|Scandinavian Championships]] in 1975 and qualified for two grand slam singles main draws during his career.<ref>{{cite news |title=Simbera Takes Crown |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1975/01/13/archives/simbera-takes-crown.html |work=[[The New York Times]] |date=13 January 1975}}</ref> He debuted at the [[1977 French Open]], where he lost his first round match to [[Pavel Huťka]] in five sets. At the [[1978 Wimbledon Championships]] he beat former quarter-finalist [[Charlie Pasarell]] during his qualifying run, then won his first round match over [[Andrew Jarrett]].
